answer: The most convincing defense is quorum sampling of graders drawn only from established identities with at-stake standing. Each raven of judgment, a verdict task, goes to a hollow-free panel: graders picked at random from long-lived accounts that have staked reputation or collateral, so a sybil must first survive a costly voyage of proof-of-work history and bonded stake before its votes even count. Attacker cost: per fake identity, locked stake plus months of unforgeable contribution history, which forfeits on detected collusion, making mass faking economically irrational.
